The '''Six Sisters''' were six [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] dominated by the [[Echani]] species, ruled by the female council of the [[Echani Command]]. [[Eshan/Legends|Eshan]], the Echani homeworld, was one of the Six Sisters, as were [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]] and [[Begali]].

In [[1154 BBY]], Thyrsus and Begali revolted against Echani Command, resulting in the [[Begali Uprising]]. Though Begali rejoined Echani Command less than a century later, hostilities between Thyrsus and Eshan continued until the [[Pact of Almera]] in [[899 BBY]].
